name: basic first three sentences
label: Message to the Hiring Manager:
cover:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply. I have five years of experience. My skills match the role. I would love to talk.

Thank you,
Jane

expect.value: I am excited to apply. I have five years of experience. My skills match the role.

spec_quote: Take the BODY: drop the salutation line (a first line starting with "Dear", "Hello", "Hi", "To whom") and everything from the sign-off on (a line starting "Sincerely", "Best regards", "Regards", "Thank you,", "Kind regards", "Best,") — the sign-off line and the lines after it.

name: label case spaces and optional decoration
label: MESSAGE   TO THE HIRING MANAGER (Optional)
cover:
Hi team,

We built a thing. It worked well. We shipped it. We will improve it.

Best regards,
Sam

expect.value: We built a thing. It worked well. We shipped it.

spec_quote: A text box (no options; type text / textarea) whose label, ignoring case, spaces and a trailing ":" / "(optional)" / "(Optional)" / "*", is one of: "message to the hiring manager", "message to the hiring team", "message to the recruiter", "message for the hiring manager", "note to the hiring manager", "add a message for the hiring manager", "personal message to the hiring manager".
